#!/bin/bash
set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/_xm_front_sync
echo '=== 同步 memory.html ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/a4ac2f125dac76a93eb6461fdb5a22aaa459e6f3/memory.html' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/memory.html?ref=a4ac2f125dac76a93eb6461fdb5a22aaa459e6f3' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 || { echo '下载失败: memory.html'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '426698f0ac0b111306cc419281bca6d0c43ed5faff35c71e9f7f552fadc1f495' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=426698f0ac0b111306cc419281bca6d0c43ed5faff35c71e9f7f552fadc1f495"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_0 '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/memory.html'
echo '=== 同步 assets/js/memory-graph-view.js ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/9eda075082671c41e19c90049fd430528507ab34/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js?ref=9eda075082671c41e19c90049fd430528507ab34' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 || { echo '下载失败: assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '1df65ef4c3cf075628a78c74d850de8706f0a7e69620d7b1ebe8c49a422a2f00' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=1df65ef4c3cf075628a78c74d850de8706f0a7e69620d7b1ebe8c49a422a2f00"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_1 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/memory-graph-view.js'
echo '=== 同步 assets/css/memory-graph.css ==='
rm -f /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2
curl -fsSL 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/a011ba30f228bedab0fcbdfb41dd130eb6c26a14/assets/css/memory-graph.css' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || curl -fsSL -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -H 'User-Agent: xinmo-vps-sync' 'https://api.github.com/repos/mo-xing-alt/xinmo-site/contents/assets/css/memory-graph.css?ref=a011ba30f228bedab0fcbdfb41dd130eb6c26a14' -o /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 || { echo '下载失败: assets/css/memory-graph.css'; exit 11; }
GOT_SHA=$(sha256sum /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 | awk '{print $1}')
if [ "$GOT_SHA" != '014fef392fa1f6ffff10e95b5be59a5fef8a37fa5341d26769923bf499960ba0' ]; then echo "SHA256 不匹配: got=$GOT_SHA expect=014fef392fa1f6ffff10e95b5be59a5fef8a37fa5341d26769923bf499960ba0"; exit 12; fi
sudo install -D -m 644 -o root -g root /tmp/_xm_front_sync/f_2 '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
ls -l --time-style=+%H:%M:%S '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
sha256sum '/var/www/xinmo-site/assets/css/memory-graph.css'
rm -rf /tmp/_xm_front_sync
